name: intelidress
description: Style outfits from the clothes you own: ChatGPT reads your InteliDress closet, puts outfits together itself and shows each as an outfit card with your photos, and saves looks and plans into the app.

interface.longDescription:
InteliDress connects ChatGPT to the wardrobe you keep in the InteliDress app for iPhone and Android. Needs InteliDress 1.1 or later.

Ask what to wear and ChatGPT works from your real closet: it reads every piece you own with its details, finds pieces from a vague description, puts outfits together with its own sense of style, dressed for the day's weather, and shows each one as an outfit card like the app's, with your photos, the weather it's for and a Save button, plans your week, suggests capsules for trips, and knows how often you wear each piece. When you like a look, ChatGPT can save it, put it on your calendar or log what you wore. Saved changes appear in the app the next time you open it.

Who it's for: people who keep their clothes in InteliDress.

To connect: in the app, turn on Settings → AI assistants. When the InteliDress sign-in page opens, approve the connection in the app: on your phone, tap Approve in InteliDress; on a computer, scan the page's QR code with your phone. You can let ChatGPT only look, without saving. Disconnect at any time in the app.

Limits: ChatGPT sees the copy of your closet that the app last synced. It adds looks, capsules, calendar plans and wear entries but never edits or deletes anything. InteliDress has no forecast of its own: ChatGPT looks up the weather, or you tell it the conditions.
capabilities: See your clothes and their photos
Suggest outfits from your own closet
Plan a week of outfits and capsules for trips
Save looks, calendar plans and wear entries into the app
defaultPrompt: What should I wear to work tomorrow?
Plan my outfits for this week.
Pack a capsule wardrobe for a 4-day trip to Lisbon.

positive.description: Closet overview from the demo account
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo closet as an InteliDress card: photo tiles of its 36 pieces with category chips (8 tops, 6 bottoms, 3 dresses, 5 outerwear, 4 shoes, 5 bags, 5 accessories) that filter the tiles, and sums it up in a sentence or two.

positive.prompt: What looks do I have saved?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo closet's saved looks (9 in a fresh demo account, more once looks are saved) as an InteliDress card, each one a small board of its pieces' photos with the look's name and occasion, and names a few of them.

positive.description: An outfit made from the user's own clothes
positive.prompt: What should I wear to the office tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: Puts together a work outfit made only of pieces from the demo closet (for example Crisp White Shirt, Black Tailored Trousers, Black Leather Loafers and Camel Wool Coat) and shows it as an outfit card: the pieces' own photos laid out together, the look's name and note, tomorrow's weather when ChatGPT found the forecast, and a Save to Looks button. It invents no clothes the closet doesn't have and shows no pictures from the web.

positive.prompt: Plan my outfits for the next 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a week-plan card with an outfit for each of the next 7 days, dated from today, every piece from the demo closet, each with a short note and that day's weather when ChatGPT found the forecast, and an Add week to calendar button.

positive.description: Save a look and put it on the calendar
positive.prompt: Save a look called Office Monday with my Crisp White Shirt, Black Tailored Trousers and Black Leather Loafers, and put it on my calendar for next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the look Office Monday with those three pieces and schedules it for next Monday's date. Each step shows as an InteliDress card with the pieces' own photos: the saved look marked Saved, then the look tagged Planned with the date and On your calendar. ChatGPT confirms both in a sentence or two and says they appear in the InteliDress app the next time it opens. Asking "What's on my calendar next Monday?" afterwards shows it (get_calendar).

negative.description: Shopping is out of scope: InteliDress only knows the clothes the user owns and can't buy anything. Expected: no InteliDress tool is used to buy or save anything; the assistant says it can't shop through InteliDress, and may offer black pieces the user already owns.
negative.prompt: Buy me a new black blazer.

negative.description: Deleting is out of scope: InteliDress tools never edit or delete. Expected: nothing is deleted and no write tool is called; the assistant explains that saved looks are deleted in the InteliDress app.
negative.prompt: Delete all the looks I've saved in InteliDress.

negative.description: Other people's closets are out of reach: the connection covers only the connected user's own closet. Expected: no one else's data is returned; the assistant explains it can only see the user's own closet.
negative.prompt: Show me my sister's closet in InteliDress.

review.commerce_description: InteliDress sells nothing through ChatGPT and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: ChatGPT reads your closet, puts outfits, week plans and trip capsules together itself and shows them as outfit cards with your photos, and saves looks, calendar plans and wear entries into the app.
